name: Termux
shortDescription: A terminal emulator and Linux environment for Android, with package management and shell tools.
description: Termux provides an Android terminal environment and a Linux package collection. It is useful for command-line workflows, scripting, learning Linux fundamentals and running supported packages on a compatible Android device.
features: Supports shell scripting and common command-line workflows
safetyNote: Install from the official project sources and review the release notes for your Android version.

name: Spam SMS
shortDescription: An SMS testing tool designed to send multiple text messages for authorized testing.
description: Spam SMS is described as an SMS pumper application designed to send multiple text messages. Use only with authorized recipients and compatible services, and avoid unsolicited messaging or message flooding.
features: Designed for sending multiple SMS messages
safetyNote: Use only for authorized testing with consent. Unsolicited bulk messaging may violate laws, carrier policies, or service terms.

name: ConnectBot
shortDescription: An SSH client for securely connecting to remote systems from Android.
description: ConnectBot is an SSH client for Android that can connect to remote servers using secure shell. It is useful for administering systems you control and working with command-line sessions while away from a desktop.
safetyNote: Verify server fingerprints and protect private keys and login credentials.
